verdict.rationale: All MCP evidence describes Rive exposing an MCP server so external AI clients (e.g., Claude, coding agents) can call into the Rive Editor's own tools (rive-docs-19, rive-probe-4, rive-probe-rt-2) — the reverse relationship from the story, which asks whether Rive can plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence shows Rive's built-in AI agent connecting to or consuming third-party MCP servers.
